Rank 18 - Transport

Bus Counter Seat and Ticket Manager

Counter-based transport needs live seats, agent commission, route sales, and no double-booking.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 25,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 1,500Recommended monthly charge

BDT 1,500/month is possible because operators have higher transaction volume and double-booking is costly.

7.3Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 25,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 1,500Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 8,600,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Target small bus operators, counters, route-based micro operators, and agent counters that still manage seats manually.

Seats get double-sold, agent cash is unclear, and route performance is not visible.

No double seat, clear counter sales, and agent commission in one place.

Validation signals

  • Transport ticketing solutions already exist, proving the workflow.
  • Manual counters still have pain.
  • Operators can pay more than shops.
  • Agent commission is a strong hook.

MVP modules

  • Route setup
  • Seat map
  • Counter ticket
  • Agent commission
  • Trip sales
  • Cancellation note
  • Daily counter report

Do not build first

  • Do not build national passenger marketplace first.
  • Do not add payment gateway first.
  • Do not support every transport mode.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Start with one route operator.
  • Build fixed seat layout.
  • Train counter staff.
  • Add online booking later.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Operational complexity.
  • Counter staff resistance.
  • Refund disputes.
Mitigations
  • Start with one route.
  • Fast ticket printing.
  • Clear cancellation log.
